title: No designated authority to act on model-generated (predicted) epidemic alerts
national_evidence: CM-PSNLP-2024-2028 (Ministère de la Santé Publique / PNLP, 2024), p. 106
recommendation: Designate in regulation which body may act on a model-generated alert, at which confidence, and how the decision and its evidence are recorded.
ai_readiness: D7 Strategy Alignment; D10 AI & Policies

title: No standard for validating and monitoring a model before and after deployment
national_evidence: CM-PSNSN-2026-2030 (Ministère de la Santé Publique, 2026), p. 30
recommendation: Require external validation, a declared validity envelope, local calibration before new-region use, and post-deployment drift monitoring.
ai_readiness: D4 Contextualization and Regional Impact; D5 Level of Integration of AI in Workflows; D10 AI & Policies

title: No standard for siting and calibrating environmental sensors used for health decisions
national_evidence: CM-PSNLP-2024-2028 (Ministère de la Santé Publique / PNLP, 2024), p. 27
recommendation: Reference a siting/calibration standard (e.g. national meteorological service practice) for any sensor feeding a health model, and certify nodes before use.

title: Security baseline for low-cost IoT health-surveillance networks
national_evidence: CM-PSNSN-2026-2030 (Ministère de la Santé Publique, 2026), p. 41
recommendation: Set a minimum security baseline (authentication, encryption, key management) for IoT nodes feeding public-health systems.

title: No framework for routine data sharing between health, meteorology and telecom actors
national_evidence: CM-PSNLP-2019-2023 (Ministère de la Santé Publique / PNLP, 2019), p. 29
practice_examples: AU-AI-STRATEGY-2024 (African Union, 2024), p. 31–32 | WHO-AI-ETHICS-2021 (World Health Organization, 2021), p. 104
recommendation: Adopt data-sharing agreements between health, meteorology and network operators, with a common schema for climate-health data.
ai_readiness: D3 Cross-Domain Correlation Analysis; D7 Strategy Alignment
